exact: modulation by symbiont of host inflammatory response
perturbation by symbiont of host inflammatory response
broad: modulation by organism of inflammatory response of other organism involved in symbiotic interaction

definition: A process in which a symbiont alters or subverts the normal execution of the  inflammatory response of the host organism; the inflammatory response is the immediate defensive reaction (by vertebrate tissue) to infection or injury caused by chemical or physical agents. The host is defined as the larger of the organisms involved in a symbiotic interaction.
label: symbiont-mediated perturbation of host inflammatory response
